info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payout API provides access to detailed information regarding insurance claims payouts. Users can retrieve data on various claims, including their status and payout amounts, facilitating efficient management of claims. This endpoint is particularly useful for insurance companies, claims adjusters, and financial analysts looking to analyze payout patterns and improve the claims process. With this API, stakeholders can ensure timely and informed decision-making related to claims management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of payouts related to claims. It provides information such as amounts, statuses, and any relevant dates concerning the payout process.
